caption: The drawing depicts a handheld wooden object, primarily composed of different shades of brown, suggestive of natural wood grain. The object has an elongated, oval-shaped body with a smoothly contoured outline. Attached perpendicular to the body on the lower left side is a rounded, slightly tapered handle, showing visible wood texture and joint lines. The top portion of the object features two rectangular, parallel wooden slats placed side by side along the length of the body. On the right side of the body, one end of the slats is secured by a square wooden plate held in place with four screws, depicted as circles. The wood grain patterns and the shading give the image a three-dimensional, realistic appearance. The background is a plain, pale off-white color with no additional objects or details. Beneath the drawing, there is a handwritten signature in red ink reading “Maurice N. Hanson.”
title: Watchman's Rattle
